title: Texas homeowners win control of their park, roads and ponds after a decade-long legal battle
summary_full: In a significant turn of events, residents of La Bota Ranch in Laredo officially gained control over common property areas after a protracted legal battle. This shift follows a jury's March 2022 decision that found developers had breached fiduciary duties, prompting residents to reevaluate governance due to rising association fees. The final handover on August 20, 2026, empowers homeowners over shared facilities, symbolizing a hard-won victory for community representation.
